[Bash](https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/) (Bourne Again SHell) is the default command-line shell on many Linux systems, including NixOS.

## Installation

Bash is included and enabled by default in NixOS.

### Home Manager

Bash can also be configured by <a href="Home_Manager" class="wikilink" title="Home Manager">Home Manager</a>. Module options can be looked up at the [Home Manager Option Search](https://home-manager-options.extranix.com/?query=programs.bash&release=master)
